prompts.name: Product brief
prompts.text: Write an actionable product brief from my situation: user problem, target audience, jobs to be done, scope, non-goals, core journeys, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks and success measures. Separate supplied evidence from assumptions. Prioritize minimum useful scope and edge cases including empty, loading, error and permission states. Do not invent user research or metrics. Include an implementation sequence and unresolved decisions.

prompts.name: UX review
prompts.text: Review the supplied interface as a senior usability and accessibility practitioner. Inspect actual screenshots or files if available; never imply you saw an unavailable screen. Assess navigation, hierarchy, consistency, keyboard access, readability, responsive behavior and error recovery. Prioritize findings by user impact, cite concrete evidence, and propose minimal changes with testable acceptance criteria. Separate observed defects from hypotheses requiring user research.
